summary: Exhaustive full-site sweep across ALL 41 routes requested by main agent on Intrinsic marketing site, plus /admin after login. For every route captured: browser console errors, failed network requests (4xx/5xx excluding expected /api/resources 404 and favicon), broken images (naturalWidth===0), body text length, and horizontal-overflow at 390/768/1280/1920 viewports. Admin login with admin@intrinsic.io / Intrinsic#Admin2026 succeeds and /admin dashboard loads with zero console errors and zero failed requests. Hero-wipe regression previously fixed in iteration_5 remains intact (spot-checked). No visual glitches, broken images, overflow, or script errors detected. Site is ready for GitHub push / deploy from a frontend-health perspective.
critical_code_review_comments: No regressions found across 41 routes at 4 viewports each (164 route+viewport combinations). All pages pass the overflow check (scrollWidth<=innerWidth+2px). No JS runtime errors, no 4xx/5xx asset or JS/CSS failures, no broken on any page.

Admin auth happy-path verified end-to-end (login -> /admin dashboard loads with populated widgets).
